faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about NexusFTP

q1.question: What protocols does NexusFTP support?
q1.answer: NexusFTP supports FTP (File Transfer Protocol), FTPS (FTP over SSL/TLS both implicit and explicit modes), and SFTP (SSH File Transfer Protocol) for secure encrypted transfers.

q2.question: Is my data secure?
q2.answer: Absolutely. All transfers use military-grade AES-256 encryption. Saved passwords are encrypted using industry-standard algorithms. SFTP connections use SSH key authentication support.

q3.question: Can I transfer large files?
q3.answer: Yes, NexusFTP is optimized for large file transfers with chunked upload/download, automatic resume capability, and progress tracking for files of any size.

q4.question: Does it support drag and drop?
q4.answer: Yes, full drag-and-drop support between local and remote panels, including multi-file selection and folder transfers.

q5.question: Can I synchronize folders?
q5.answer: Yes, the smart sync feature detects changes and can automatically synchronize folders between local and remote systems.

q6.question: Is there a file preview?
q6.answer: Yes, built-in preview for images, PDFs, text files, JSON, source code with syntax highlighting, and Markdown rendering.
